title: Age/eligibility gate: no '21+' wording, and disabled CTA gives no feedback and is not focusable
persona: New Android Chrome visitor wanting to install the PWA
steps: Read the checkbox label next to 'Start 7-day free trial'
Tap the CTA with the box unchecked
expected: Gate says the visitor is 21+ (or of legal age); tapping a disabled CTA explains what to tick; button reachable by keyboard/TalkBack.
actual: Label reads 'I am legally allowed to bet where I live.' (no 21+). Unchecked CTA is an <a> with no href, aria-disabled, tabIndex 0 reported but not a real link/button; tap does nothing and shows no message. With box ticked the href becomes https://whop.com/checkout/qa-trial-plan (works). Footer does say 21+.
